dataset: Smart irrigation control system data with soil moisture, flow meter and electrovalve relay
notes: File names, columns, row counts, and checksums were inspected in the published file previews.
Moisture is the source sensor percentage, not verified volumetric water content.
The derived supervised target is an observed valve opening within the next hour while currently closed.
Weather, crop-stage variation, and agronomic optimality are not labeled by this dataset.
